findings.quote: We must not allow artificial intelligence rather than humans to take legally binding decisions. Humans must retain control.
findings.rationale: Warns of AI surveillance and privacy risks and insists on human control of legally binding decisions.

findings.quote: The United Nations must therefore actively promote the discussion of personal data protection in cyberspace, especially the ethical and legal standards for the collection and use of personal data.
findings.rationale: The explicit therefore continues the preceding AI, surveillance and personal-data argument into a request for UN ethical and legal discussion.
